hearth.upkeep.check_updates.note.lore: Asks GitHub for a newer release at launch and before a scheduled restart. Nothing is installed unless the switch below is on.

hearth.upkeep.auto_update.note.lore: Fetches new releases at launch and on restarts.

hearth.upkeep.hexium.off.toast.lore: Hexium is off. BakaLoader will not contact it.

hearth.upkeep.start_minimized.note.lore: The window opens minimized to the taskbar. BakaLoader has no tray icon, so it waits there rather than in the notification area.

hearth.upkeep.norse_names.title.lore: On: every plain label keeps its Norse name as a caption. Off: plain English only.

hearth.upkeep.norse_names.note.lore: Keeps Hearth, Vikings and Saga beside their plain names.

mods.index.line.unread.lore: {count} loaded · Thunderstore index not read yet

mods.index.line.unread.both.lore: {count} loaded · Thunderstore and Hexium not read yet

mods.menu.update.tip.patcher.lore: Patcher mods are not updated here.

mods.menu.update.tip.hexium.lore: This copy came from Hexium, so Thunderstore updates are not applied to it.

mods.menu.update.tip.current.lore: This mod is already up to date.

mods.menu.update.tip.not_listed.lore: Thunderstore is not listing this mod at the moment, so there is nothing to update it to.

mods.menu.check_one.tip.bundled.lore: This plugin ships inside BakaLoader, so there is no Thunderstore package to ask about.

mods.menu.check_one.tip.no_package.lore: This folder does not name a Thunderstore package, so there is nothing to ask about.

mods.hexium.consent.note.lore: This download comes from Hexium, not Thunderstore. BakaLoader cannot tell you who published it: the site does not say who runs it, and its accounts are Discord sign-ins, so a name there is not proof of the same person on Thunderstore.

mods.hexium.consent.replacing.lore: A folder for this mod is already installed and will be replaced. The old copy is backed up first.

mods.hexium.consent.fresh.lore: This mod is not installed on this server yet, so nothing is replaced.

mods.hexium.consent.deps.lore: This package says it needs these, and BakaLoader does not fetch them for you:

mods.hexium.consent.running.lore: The server is RUNNING. A new mod only loads after a restart, and locked files may fail to replace.

mods.swap.body.lore: This copy came from Hexium. Installing the Thunderstore build replaces those files and hands the mod back to the ordinary update path, so it joins Update all again.

mods.swap.warn.lore: The installed folder is backed up and then replaced.

mods.add.hexium_note.lore: A hexium.gg address works here as well. BakaLoader will show you what it found and ask before it fetches anything.

mods.add.placeholder.link.lore: paste a Thunderstore or Hexium link

world.field.seed.rune.title.lore: Seed is set at world creation and can never change

world.field.seed.input.title.lore: A world's seed is fixed at creation and cannot be changed

world.pwcheck.note.lore: Valheim itself wants at least 5 characters and turns down a password holding the server or the world name. With this on, BakaLoader stops the start and says which rule was broken; with it off, it starts anyway and leaves the last word to the game. Applies to every realm.

world.mod.death.help.aria.lore: What each Death Penalty option does

world.mods.note.lore: modifiers saved per world · max players above 10 installs a small bundled server plugin · applies the next time the server starts

world.server_exe.open.title.lore: Open the server folder in Explorer

world.save_dir.open.title.lore: Open the save data folder in Explorer

world.setup.reset.title.lore: Clear the saved setup answers and run the guided first-time setup again

world.setup.reset.note.lore: resets setup answers only · server files and worlds are never touched

atlas.recenter.title.lore: Fit the whole world in view

atlas.redraw.title.lore: Re-render the map from the world seed

atlas.roster.note.lore: A map drawn without mods cannot follow players, so this card names who is online instead.

saga.vellum.title.lore: The Vellum: where the log files are kept, and what gets written

saga.copy.title.lore: Copy the visible lines to the clipboard

herald.head.sub.lore: one Discord post · edits itself · never floods the channel

herald.wiz.title.lore: Guided setup: create a webhook in Discord, paste it here, choose what to share, publish the first post

herald.sharing.toggle.title.lore: Master switch. On: the status post keeps itself up to date. Off: nothing is ever sent.

herald.field.webhook.title.lore: In Discord: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → pick a channel → Copy Webhook URL. The setup wizard walks you through it.

herald.field.thread.title.lore: Optional. Only for posting inside a thread or forum post: right-click the thread → Copy Thread ID (needs Discord developer mode, under App Settings → Advanced). Blank = post directly in the channel.

herald.thread.placeholder.lore: optional · blank = post in the channel itself

herald.carries.note.lore: Always: server name, status, players online, world, mod count, last mod update, next restart. Optional extras:

herald.share.address.title.lore: Include the server's public IP and port so friends copy it straight from Discord.

herald.share.password.title.lore: Include the password in the post. Anyone who can read the channel sees it, so use it only for private channels.

herald.share.password.warn.lore: ᚦ the password is visible to everyone in that channel, so trusted halls only

herald.share.events.title.lore: Also send one-off messages when the server starts, stops or crashes, and when vikings join or leave. These are separate messages, not edits of the status post.

herald.share.events.note.lore: one-off messages for start · stop · crash · join · leave

herald.publish.title.lore: Create the status post now, or refresh it immediately if it already exists

herald.remove.title.lore: Delete the status post from Discord. Settings stay, so you can publish again any time.

skald.reset.title.lore: Clear every counted number and start the journal again

appupd.side.title.lore: A newer BakaLoader is ready. Open it for what happens next.

appupd.pill.title.running.lore: A newer BakaLoader is ready. Open it to choose when it installs.

appupd.pill.title.idle.lore: A newer BakaLoader is ready. Open it to install now.

appupd.refusal.server_busy.lore: A server or a Steam update is still running. Try again once it has finished.

appupd.refusal.checking_off.lore: Update checking is off in Upkeep. Turn it back on and BakaLoader can fetch this.

appupd.refusal.cooldown.lore: BakaLoader just checked. Give it a minute and try again.

appupd.refusal.not_available.lore: Nothing newer came back. BakaLoader is already on the newest release it can see, or the release has not finished publishing yet.

appupd.refusal.offline.lore: BakaLoader could not reach GitHub. Check the connection and try again.

appupd.refusal.other.lore: BakaLoader could not fetch the update right now. Try again later.

appupd.modal.running.body.lore: Installing it restarts BakaLoader, and that stops your server, so BakaLoader will not do it while a world is up.

appupd.modal.running.note.lore: Set it for the next restart and the new version installs itself the next time BakaLoader closes.

appupd.modal.idle.body.lore: Nothing is running, so this can happen now. BakaLoader closes, swaps itself for the new version and opens again.

appupd.modal.idle.note.lore: Your profiles, worlds and mods are left alone.

appupd.modal.go.off.title.lore: Update checking is off in Upkeep.

appupd.notes.preview.toast.lore: Release notes open in the app

appupd.notes.failed.lore: The release page could not be opened from here.

appupd.modal.save_failed.lore: That setting could not be saved. Try the Upkeep card.

appupd.modal.armed.toast.lore: BakaLoader installs the new version the next time it closes

appupd.modal.fetched.toast.lore: Fetched. BakaLoader closes and opens again on the new version

guard.body.update_pending.risk.lore: Starting now runs the old build, and players who already updated cannot join.

guard.body.build_changed.risk.lore: Starting will upgrade your worlds to the new version. Older servers cannot read upgraded worlds.

guard.note.unknown_install.lore: BakaLoader cannot tell how this server was installed, so it cannot update it for you. Open Steam and update Valheim Dedicated Server there.

guard.note.standalone.lore: BakaLoader copies the worlds aside, updates this install with steamcmd, then starts the server.

guard.note.steam_library.lore: BakaLoader copies the worlds aside, asks Steam to download the update, then starts the server.

guard.note.backup.lore: A backup copies every world in this server's save folder aside first, and the Barrow can put one back.
guard.note.backup.plain: A backup copies every world in this server's save folder aside first, and the backup manager can put one back.

srvupd.block.msg.lore: An update is running for this install. Wait for it to finish.

srvupd.phase.asking_steam.lore: Asking Steam to download the update

srvupd.phase.cancelled.lore: Stopped waiting. Steam carries on downloading on its own.

srvupd.prompt.question.lore: Back up the worlds before the update?

srvupd.row.stop.title.lore: Stop watching for the download. Steam carries on with it.

srvupd.row.locked.title.lore: An update cannot be stopped part way through writing files.

srvupd.cancel_refused.toast.lore: This update cannot be stopped now. It is writing files.

srvupd.stopped.toast.lore: Update stopped. Steam keeps downloading on its own.

srvupd.pill.ready.title.lore: Download and apply the waiting Valheim server update

srvupd.pill.blocked.title.lore: BakaLoader cannot apply this update itself. Open Steam and update the dedicated server there.

cond.save.body.lore: Everything played since the last good save is only in memory. Check free disk space, and whether anything else has the world files open.

cond.backup.body.lore: The worlds could not be copied aside, so the server was not started.

cond.crash.body.relaunch.lore: The server process stopped on its own. BakaLoader is relaunching it.

cond.crash.body.down.lore: The server process stopped on its own. It stays down until you start it.

cond.plugin.body.lore: A plugin BakaLoader installs alongside the server could not be put in place.

cond.restart.body.lore: Saved settings differ from what the running server started with. They apply at the next restart.

cond.appupd.manual.running.lore: It will not install while a world is up. Open Update BakaLoader to set it for the next restart, or turn auto-update on in Upkeep.

cond.appupd.manual.idle.lore: It will not install on its own. Install it now with Update BakaLoader, or turn auto-update on in Upkeep and it goes in the next time you close the app.

cond.appupd.auto.lore: It installs the next time you close the app.

cond.appupd.checking_off.lore: Update checking is off in Upkeep, so nothing installs itself until you turn it back on.

realm.delete.running.toast.lore: Stop the server before deleting it.

realm.delete.files.label.lore: Also delete this realm's isolated worlds, backups & install
realm.delete.files.label.plain: Also delete this world's isolated worlds, backups & install

realm.delete.shared.note.lore: This realm shares its install and worlds, so there are no isolated files to remove.
realm.delete.shared.note.plain: This world shares its install and worlds, so there are no isolated files to remove.

realm.delete.body.lore: By default this removes only the saved settings. The realm can be re-adopted later from its world files.
realm.delete.body.plain: By default this removes only the saved settings. The world can be re-adopted later from its world files.

realm.delete.failed.lore: Delete failed. See the saga log.

realm.restore.none.toast.lore: Nothing to restore: no archived realms or past worlds found.

realm.restore.orphans.note.lore: Worlds no realm currently owns. Bringing one back makes a fresh isolated server. The original files are left untouched.
realm.restore.orphans.note.plain: Worlds no world currently owns. Bringing one back makes a fresh isolated server. The original files are left untouched.

realm.adopt.mods.label.lore: Copy the active realm's mods into it
realm.adopt.mods.label.plain: Copy the active world's mods into it

realm.adopt.status.lore: The world files are copied. The original is left untouched.

realm.adopt.name.taken.lore: A realm by that name already exists.
realm.adopt.name.taken.plain: A world by that name already exists.

realm.adopt.failed.lore: Could not bring that world back. See the saga log.
realm.adopt.failed.plain: Could not bring that world back. See the log.

realm.new.seed.note.lore: only for a brand-new world · fixed forever once created

realm.new.difficulty.note.lore: World difficulty · leave on Normal for the standard game, or set it now so the realm is born this way on its first launch
realm.new.difficulty.note.plain: World difficulty · leave on Normal for the standard game, or set it now so the world is born this way on its first launch

realm.new.seedmods.label.lore: Copy this server's mods to start

realm.new.name.taken.lore: A realm by that name already burns.
realm.new.name.taken.plain: A world by that name already burns.

realm.new.status.provisioning.lore: provisioning a separate install (this can take a moment)…

realm.new.failed.lore: Could not forge that realm. See the saga log.
realm.new.failed.plain: Could not mods that world. See the log.

saga.vellum.folder.note.lore: blank = the default · must be a full path (e.g. D:\ValheimLogs) · new scrolls land here; a running session keeps writing its current file
saga.vellum.folder.note.plain: blank = the default · must be a full path (e.g. D:\ValheimLogs) · new log files land here; a running session keeps writing its current file

saga.vellum.save.failed.lore: could not save: the folder must be a full, writable path (e.g. D:\ValheimLogs)

saga.term.gated.placeholder.lore: broadcast sleeps. Install the RCON and devcommands mods (see the Players page)

world.delete.block.no_world.lore: there is no world here to delete

world.delete.block.no_folder.lore: this world's folder is not known, so it cannot be deleted from here

world.delete.backups.gone.lore: Its backup layers go with it, so there is nothing left to bring back.
world.delete.backups.gone.plain: Its backup backups go with it, so there is nothing left to bring back.

world.delete.backups.kept.lore: Its backup layers stay in the Barrow, so the world can still be raised from one of them.
world.delete.backups.kept.plain: Its backup backups stay in the backup manager, so the world can still be raised from one of them.

world.delete.confirm.label.lore: Type the world's name to confirm

world.delete.warning.lore: There is no undo, and nothing else on this machine holds this world.

world.delete.button.title.lore: Delete this world and everything the game keeps with it

barrow.orphans.note.lore: layers left behind by a world that is no longer on disk. Restore one to bring that world back, or delete one to reclaim the space.
barrow.orphans.note.plain: backups left behind by a world that is no longer on disk. Restore one to bring that world back, or delete one to reclaim the space.

barrow.note.lore: every realm's layers: automatic snapshots, the game's last good pair, and the safety copies laid down before each restore
barrow.note.plain: every world's backups: automatic snapshots, the game's last good pair, and the safety copies laid down before each restore

barrow.layer.block.damaged.lore: This layer lost its world file, so there is nothing to restore from it. You can still delete it.
barrow.layer.block.damaged.plain: This backup lost its world file, so there is nothing to restore from it. You can still delete it.

barrow.layer.block.uncommitted.lore: This snapshot holds no finished save, so there is nothing to restore from it yet.

barrow.layer.restore.title.lore: Unearth this layer: put this backup back
barrow.layer.restore.title.plain: Restore this backup: put this backup back

barrow.world.running.note.lore: this realm is raiding right now. Stop the server to unearth a layer
barrow.world.running.note.plain: this world is online right now. Stop the server to restore a backup

barrow.layer.restore.running.toast.lore: Stop the server first. The live realm would clobber the restored files
barrow.layer.restore.running.toast.plain: Stop the server first. The live world would clobber the restored files

skald.reset.confirm.body.lore: Uptime, starts, crashes, playtime, sessions, deaths and the mod chronicle all go back to nothing, for every realm, because they are counted in one journal on this machine.
skald.reset.confirm.body.plain: Uptime, starts, crashes, playtime, sessions, deaths and the mod chronicle all go back to nothing, for every world, because they are counted in one journal on this machine.

skald.reset.confirm.note.lore: The old journal is set aside as one backup copy beside it, and the counting starts again from now.

world.seed.not_created.lore: not created yet · seed set on first launch

world.seed.none.toast.lore: no seed yet · world not created

world.running.note.lore: The server is running. Saved changes apply the next time it starts.

world.difficulty.not_saved.toast.lore: World difficulty was not saved for this world. Reopen Settings and save again.

world.saved.running.toast.lore: Saved. The running server keeps its current settings until it restarts.

world.pwcheck.on.toast.lore: password rule on · a short password stops the start

world.pwcheck.off.toast.lore: password rule off · the game has the last word

world.format.legacy.toast.lore: Old world format · the next save converts it

mods.hexium.source_off.toast.lore: Turn on Also check Hexium in Upkeep to install from Hexium.

mods.hexium.preview.toast.lore: Installing from Hexium runs in the app.

mods.check_one.cooldown.toast.lore: that one was just checked; give it a moment

mods.check_one.bad_name.toast.lore: this folder does not name a Thunderstore package

mods.check_one.unreachable.toast.lore: Thunderstore did not answer. Try again in a little while.

mods.check_one.not_listed.toast.lore: {name} is not listed on Thunderstore right now

mods.check_one.held.toast.lore: Thunderstore has {version} · this copy came from Hexium, so BakaLoader leaves it where it is

srvupd.worlds_copy.failed.toast.lore: Could not copy the worlds aside · server not started

setup.wiz.done.note.lore: Everything can be changed any time in the WORLD hall. Name your server, pick a world, and sail forth.
setup.wiz.done.note.plain: Everything can be changed any time in the WORLD hall. Name your server, pick a world, and connect.

herald.wiz.intro.body.lore: The Herald keeps one status post in a Discord channel of your choosing and quietly edits that same post whenever the realm changes. It never sends a stream of messages, so your channel stays clean.
herald.wiz.intro.body.plain: Discord sharing keeps one status post in a Discord channel of your choosing and quietly edits that same post whenever the world changes. It never sends a stream of messages, so your channel stays clean.

herald.wiz.intro.choose.body.lore: whether the join address, the password, and one-off event posts are included.

herald.wiz.intro.need.body.lore: a Discord server where you can manage webhooks (or a friendly admin who can). Takes about a minute.

herald.wiz.hook.body.lore: A webhook is a private posting address for one channel. In Discord:

herald.wiz.hook.step1.lore: open your Discord server and click its name → Server Settings

herald.wiz.hook.step3.lore: name it (say, BakaLoader Herald) and pick the channel the post should live in
herald.wiz.hook.step3.plain: name it (say, BakaLoader Discord) and pick the channel the post should live in

herald.wiz.hook.step4.lore: press Copy Webhook URL and paste it below

herald.wiz.hook.stat.idle.lore: paste the URL · the Herald will knock on it to make sure it answers
herald.wiz.hook.stat.idle.plain: paste the URL · the Discord post will knock on it to make sure it answers

herald.wiz.hook.stat.bad.lore: that webhook does not answer · re-copy the URL from Discord

herald.wiz.hook.thread.placeholder.lore: blank = post in the channel itself

herald.wiz.hook.thread.note.lore: Thread ID is only for posting inside a thread or forum post: right-click the thread → Copy Thread ID (needs Developer Mode, under App Settings → Advanced). Most people leave this blank.

herald.wiz.share.body.lore: The post always shows name, status, players, world, mods and the next restart. Decide what else rides along. Everything can be changed later in the HERALD hall.
herald.wiz.share.body.plain: The post always shows name, status, players, world, mods and the next restart. Decide what else rides along. Everything can be changed later in the DISCORD hall.

herald.wiz.share.password.title.lore: Include the password in the post. Anyone who can read the channel sees it.

herald.wiz.share.password.warn.lore: everyone in that channel will see the password, so use private channels only

herald.wiz.share.events.title.lore: Also send one-off messages for server start/stop/crash and player join/leave. Separate messages, not edits of the status post.

herald.wiz.share.events.note.lore: Event posts are extra one-off messages (start · stop · crash · join · leave). Leave off for the single silent status post only.

herald.wiz.sum.thread.none.lore: none · posts in the channel itself

herald.wiz.sum.note.lore: Finish places the first post. From then on the Herald edits that same post whenever the realm changes, and you never need to touch it again.
herald.wiz.sum.note.plain: Finish places the first post. From then on the Discord post edits that same post whenever the world changes, and you never need to touch it again.

waystone.wiz.intro.body.lore: A Waystone gives your server a name. Friends type valheim.your-domain.com instead of a raw IP. The name survives IP changes: update one DNS record and every join prompt, copy chip and Discord post follows.
waystone.wiz.intro.body.plain: A Domain gives your server a name. Friends type valheim.your-domain.com instead of a raw IP. The name survives IP changes: update one DNS record and every join prompt, copy chip and Discord post follows.

waystone.wiz.intro.need.body.lore: a domain you own (any registrar), or a free dynamic-DNS name (DuckDNS, No-IP). Nothing is bought or installed here. This wizard only teaches your DNS to point at this server.

waystone.wiz.intro.shows.body.lore: Sail Forth join prompts, the Network card, Copy join address, and the Herald's Discord post all prefer the name once it's raised.
waystone.wiz.intro.shows.body.plain: Copy Join Info join prompts, the Network card, Copy join address, and the Discord post's Discord post all prefer the name once it's raised.

waystone.wiz.remove.title.lore: Lower the Waystone. Join surfaces go back to showing the raw public IP. Your DNS record is untouched.
waystone.wiz.remove.title.plain: Lower the Domain. Join surfaces go back to showing the raw public IP. Your DNS record is untouched.

waystone.wiz.name.body.lore: Pick the full name friends will type. A subdomain keeps your main site untouched: valheim.example.com rather than example.com. Dynamic-DNS users: paste the name your provider gave you, like mysaga.duckdns.org.

waystone.wiz.name.input.title.lore: Just the name, with no https:// and no port. Pasting a full URL is fine; it will be trimmed.

waystone.wiz.name.stat.idle.lore: type the name · letters, digits and hyphens, with at least one dot

waystone.wiz.name.stat.bad.lore: not a valid hostname: it needs a dot, no spaces and no ports, like valheim.example.com

waystone.wiz.dns.title.lore: Point the name at this server

waystone.wiz.dns.own.lore: Own domain · add an A record

waystone.wiz.dns.own.step1.lore: open your DNS provider's dashboard (Cloudflare, Namecheap, Porkbun, wherever the domain lives)

waystone.wiz.dns.own.step3.lore: TTL 300-3600 s is fine · on Cloudflare set the cloud to DNS only (grey), because the orange proxy does not carry game traffic

waystone.wiz.dns.ddns.lore: Home connection · IP changes? use dynamic DNS

waystone.wiz.dns.ddns.duckdns.lore: DuckDNS (free): claim yourname.duckdns.org, run their tiny updater so the record follows your IP

waystone.wiz.dns.ddns.noip.lore: No-IP or your router's built-in DDNS page work the same way

waystone.wiz.dns.ddns.cname.lore: own a domain AND have a changing IP? point a CNAME at your dynamic-DNS name

waystone.wiz.dns.note.lore: New records usually answer in a minute or two; some resolvers take up to an hour. The next step checks it live, and you can finish either way and re-check later.

waystone.wiz.check.note.lore: A fresh record can lag behind. If it doesn't resolve yet you can still raise the Waystone now, and it starts working the moment DNS catches up.
waystone.wiz.check.note.plain: A fresh record can lag behind. If it doesn't resolve yet you can still raise the Domain now, and it starts working the moment DNS catches up.

waystone.wiz.check.stat.failed.lore: the check itself failed, and you can still raise the Waystone
waystone.wiz.check.stat.failed.plain: the check itself failed, and you can still raise the Domain

waystone.wiz.check.stat.match.lore: the name answers with this server's IP, perfect

waystone.wiz.check.stat.mismatch.lore: the name resolves, but not to this server's public IP: a stale record, a proxy (orange cloud?), or propagation still in flight

atlas.save.unreadable.lore: The save could not be read. The saga log carries what the reader said.
atlas.save.unreadable.plain: The save could not be read. The log carries what the reader said.

atlas.save.unparsed.lore: There is a save on disk, but this reader could not make sense of it.

atlas.save.none.lore: No save file yet. The clock starts with the first launch.

atlas.wx.anchor.paused.lore: Time stands still: no vikings ashore.
atlas.wx.anchor.paused.plain: Time stands still: no players ashore.

atlas.wx.anchor.live.lore: Anchored to the last world save.

atlas.layer.shared_map.none.toast.lore: No shared map yet. The realm stays veiled until a viking presses 'Record discoveries' on a cartography table.
atlas.layer.shared_map.none.toast.plain: No shared map yet. The world stays veiled until a player presses 'Record discoveries' on a cartography table.

atlas.layer.pins.none.toast.lore: No table pins yet. Pins ride the cartography table's shared map.

hearth.saga.empty.reason.lore: Lines appear here the moment the server writes any.

hearth.saves.empty.reason.lore: Each world write is timed here once the server has saved at least once.

mods.empty.scanning.reason.lore: Reading the community index and matching it against the installed plugins.

mods.empty.unscanned.reason.lore: A scan reads this server's BepInEx folder and checks Thunderstore for newer versions.

mods.empty.none.reason.lore: Nothing was found in this server's BepInEx plugins folder. Check the server path in Settings, or add a mod from Thunderstore.

saga.empty.reason.lore: BakaLoader and the server both write here. Start the server and the first lines arrive within seconds.

barrow.saves.empty.reason.lore: The game lays down a snapshot as it saves, and BakaLoader copies the worlds aside before a build change.

barrow.worlds.empty.reason.lore: BakaLoader looks in each realm's save folder. Start a server once and its world appears here.
barrow.worlds.empty.reason.plain: BakaLoader looks in each world's save folder. Start a server once and its world appears here.

barrow.layers.empty.reason.lore: The game writes a snapshot each time it saves, and BakaLoader copies the world aside before a build change.

skald.players.empty.reason.lore: Playtime, sessions and deaths are counted from the moment the first player joins.

skald.feed.empty.reason.lore: Starts, stops, joins and deaths are listed here as they happen.

skald.mods.empty.reason.lore: Every install and update BakaLoader makes is listed here.

hearth.vikings.empty.reason.lore: Players appear here as soon as they connect.

vikings.empty.reason.lore: Players appear here as soon as they connect. Share the join address and they will show up.

atlas.roster.empty.reason.lore: Players are listed here while they are connected.

atlas.waypoints.empty.reason.lore: Altars, portals and map-table pins are read out of the world file. They appear after the server has saved once.

world.wg.combat.intro.lore: Sets how much damage you deal and take, and how often you run into higher leveled enemies.

world.wg.combat.veryeasy.explain.lore: You deal 25 percent more damage, enemies deal half their normal damage, and enemies are 10 percent smaller and slower outside dungeons.

world.wg.combat.easy.explain.lore: You deal 10 percent more damage, enemies deal 75 percent of their normal damage, and enemies are 5 percent smaller and slower outside dungeons.

world.wg.combat.normal.explain.lore: Combat plays exactly as the game ships it, with no damage, size or enemy level changes applied.

world.wg.combat.hard.explain.lore: You deal 15 percent less damage, enemies deal 50 percent more, enemies are 10 percent bigger and faster outside dungeons, and enemies are 20 percent more likely to spawn with stars.

world.wg.combat.veryhard.explain.lore: You deal 30 percent less damage, enemies deal double damage, enemies are 20 percent bigger and faster outside dungeons, and enemies are 40 percent more likely to spawn with stars.

world.wg.deathpenalty.intro.lore: Sets what happens to your items and your skills when you die.

world.wg.deathpenalty.casual.explain.lore: You do not drop equipped gear, so only the items you were not wearing go into a tombstone you can recover, and skill loss is cut to 15 percent of the normal amount.

world.wg.deathpenalty.veryeasy.explain.lore: You drop all items, equipped gear included, into a tombstone you can recover, and skill loss is cut to 15 percent of the normal amount.

world.wg.deathpenalty.easy.explain.lore: You drop all items into a tombstone you can recover, and skill loss is half the normal amount.

world.wg.deathpenalty.normal.explain.lore: You drop all items into a tombstone you can recover, and skills are reduced by the standard amount.

world.wg.deathpenalty.hard.explain.lore: Equipped items are dropped into a tombstone you can recover, everything else in your inventory is deleted for good and never reaches the tombstone, and skill loss is 1.5 times the normal amount.

world.wg.deathpenalty.hardcore.explain.lore: Every item you were carrying, equipped or not, is deleted permanently and all of your skills reset to zero, but your character itself is not deleted.

world.wg.resources.intro.lore: Sets how much material you get from gathering and from enemy drops, shown in the game as a multiplier.

world.wg.resources.muchless.explain.lore: Gathering and enemy drops give half the usual amount of materials.

world.wg.resources.less.explain.lore: Gathering and enemy drops give three quarters of the usual amount of materials.

world.wg.resources.normal.explain.lore: Materials drop at the amounts the game was balanced around.

world.wg.resources.more.explain.lore: Gathering and enemy drops give 1.5 times the usual amount of materials.

world.wg.resources.muchmore.explain.lore: Gathering and enemy drops give double the usual amount of materials.

world.wg.resources.most.explain.lore: Gathering and enemy drops give three times the usual amount of materials, the highest setting the game offers.

world.wg.raids.intro.lore: Sets how often enemies come to raid your base, called Raid Rate in the game.

world.wg.raids.none.explain.lore: The timed raid check never runs, so the usual random raids on your base stop happening.

world.wg.raids.muchless.explain.lore: Raids have to wait twice as long before they can trigger and are half as likely on each check.

world.wg.raids.less.explain.lore: Raids have to wait 50 percent longer before they can trigger and are about a third less likely on each check.

world.wg.raids.normal.explain.lore: Raids arrive at the pace the game was balanced around.

world.wg.raids.more.explain.lore: Raids can trigger after 60 percent of the usual wait and are about 1.7 times as likely on each check.

world.wg.raids.muchmore.explain.lore: Raids can trigger after 30 percent of the usual wait and are more than three times as likely on each check.

world.wg.portals.intro.lore: Changes how portals work, from carrying anything through them to having none at all.

world.wg.portals.casual.explain.lore: Allows you to bring all items with you through portals, ore and metal bars included, which skips much of the hauling the world is built around.

world.wg.portals.normal.explain.lore: Portals work as usual, so ore and metal bars still cannot be carried through them.

world.wg.portals.hard.label.lore: No boss portals, blocked during bosses

world.wg.portals.hard.explain.lore: You will not be able to use portals or exit boss dungeons while a boss is active.

world.wg.portals.veryhard.explain.lore: You will not be able to use portals to teleport yourself across the world, so every trip is made on foot or by boat.

world.wg.own_note.lore: BakaLoader applies these settings every time the server starts, and clears any leftover difficulty keys first. A difficulty change made with the in-game console does not survive a restart.
